content.text: Summary: I inspected the `search` namespace and found the Thursday reindex Job stuck at 1/2 Ready — the `reindex` container exited cleanly but the `cloud-sql-proxy` container keeps running, preventing Job completion. Combined with `concurrencyPolicy: Forbid`, that caused Friday's run to be skipped, which matches the "index hasn't refreshed since Wednesday" symptom. I resolved T-5006 with a note instructing the owner to (1) delete the stuck Job to unblock tonight's schedule, and (2) redefine `cloud-sql-proxy` as a native sidecar (initContainer with `restartPolicy: Always`) so future Jobs can complete.
